answers.text: ANSWER: The file doesn't write an outline on the three connectors (Connector 4, 6 and 8). Their width, style and colour come from the theme's shape style, so this file doesn't show what they are.

REFUSE: The connectors take their colour and line style from the theme, and a border here must be written with its width, style and colour together, so I can't set only a 3pt width while keeping the inherited colour and style.
REFUSE: This format can keep a gradient fill or replace it with a single colour, but it can't write or change a gradient's colours.
